svg.text: One FastAPI backend serves the browser over REST and agents over MCP. Both read the same signed Cards. Module names and import edges read from origin/main.
⚠ api.ts supports radius, but the search screens never pass it — so every browser search is radius=0, this hub only.
Cross-hub results are therefore invisible in the UI while working perfectly over REST and MCP. One-line frontend fix.
Keys are generated in the browser during onboarding; the folder is scanned in the page and never uploaded.
the owner token rides the header, never an argument

TWO PATHS IN, ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH
A browser and an agent reach the same hive.discover() and get the same signed Cards and the same score_breakdown.
The browser just forgets to ask for a radius — which is why the MCP path demonstrates federation today and the web UI does not.
Every ranking factor is returned, never hidden: local relevance × hub_path_trust × hop_decay (0.85 ** hops), each separately in score_breakdown.
